name: Secrets of KL - Nightlife, Street Art & Cocktails!
shortDescription: Simply Enak's after-dark crawl reveals hidden speakeasy bars and forbidden tales.
fullDescription:
Are you ready to step into the hidden corners of Kuala Lumpur's nightlife? This tour takes you beyond the tourist trail and into the city's secret drinking dens, hidden speakeasies, and late-night street food spots.

Your guide will share forbidden tales of old KL  -  from gangster histories to colonial scandals  -  while you sip handcrafted cocktails and eat some of the best late-night street food the city has to offer.

itinerary.title: Meet at Pasar Seni MRT
itinerary.description:
Meet your guide at Pasar Seni MRT Station. We'll start with an introduction to KL's street art scene before exploring the nightlife.

Pasar Seni (Central Market) is the heart of KL's arts district. From here, we'll explore the backstreets where KL's street art was born.

itinerary.title: Street Art in Chinatown
itinerary.description:
Discover hidden street art murals in Chinatown's backstreets. Learn about the artists and the stories behind each mural.

Tastings: Local street snacks

KL's street art scene exploded after 2010, when Lithuanian artist Ernest Zacharevic created murals in Georgetown. KL's artists followed suit, transforming Chinatown's backstreets.

itinerary.title: Rooftop Sunset Drinks
itinerary.description:
Enjoy sunset drinks at a hidden rooftop bar with panoramic views of KL's skyline. Learn about the city's transformation from mining camp to metropolis.

Tastings: Welcome cocktail, Local appetizers

KL's rooftop bar scene is relatively new — most opened in the last 10 years. This one offers the best view of Merdeka 118, Southeast Asia's tallest building.

itinerary.title: Speakeasy Cocktail Experience
itinerary.description:
Discover a hidden speakeasy bar behind an unmarked door. Learn about KL's growing craft cocktail scene and the bartenders pushing boundaries.

Tastings: Signature craft cocktail, Bar snacks

KL's speakeasy scene started around 2015, when bartenders began hiding bars behind bookshelves, phone booths, and unmarked doors. This one is ranked among Asia's 50 best bars.

itinerary.title: Late Night Hawker Supper
itinerary.description:
End with a late-night hawker supper at a stall that only opens after dark. This is where KL's nightlife crowd comes to refuel.

Tastings: Char kway teow, Satay, Fresh sugarcane juice

Late-night hawker stalls are KL's best-kept secret. They serve the night crowd — taxi drivers, bar staff, and party-goers looking for authentic food after midnight.

name: Penang Street Food
shortDescription: What makes Penang the food capital of Malaysia?
fullDescription:
Penang is known as the food capital of Malaysia, and what better way to discover it than to eat your way through its most iconic streets. This tour takes you from the famous Penang Road to hidden gems that only locals know.

Taste legendary Penang dishes like Asam Laksa, Char Kway Teow, and Cendol, all while learning about the Peranakan (Straits Chinese) heritage that makes Penang's food culture unique.

highlights.highlight: Chowrasta Market - feeding Georgetown since the 1890s
Watch popiah skins handcrafted by a master with 50 years of practice
Legendary Asam Laksa - perfectly balanced sweet, sour and savoury
Peranakan Nyonya kueh at Michelin-listed Moh Teng Pheow
Harmony Street - temples, mosques and churches side by side

name: Kuala Lumpur Street Food
tagline: The Heart of KL Street Food
shortDescription: Brand new to Malaysia? This is everything you need to know!
fullDescription:
When you think of Malaysia, you think of Street Food! This tour takes you through the beating heart of Kuala Lumpur's street food scene. Starting at Pasar Seni, you'll weave through the historic lanes of Chinatown and Little India.

Your guide will show you where locals really eat  -  from steam-boat noodles to char kway teow, from roti canai to cendol. Every stop has a story, and every dish tells you something about Malaysia's multicultural soul.

highlights.highlight: Real connections with family-run vendors who remember our names
Heritage + food storytelling - every dish has a story
Traditional Chinese medicine experience
Watch the last handmade BBQ buns being made
Hidden gems where locals actually eat, not tourist versions

itinerary.description: Visit temples between stops for legendary Hokkien mee and apam balik.

itinerary.title: 11:15 AM - Kwai Chai Hong & REX KL
itinerary.description: Discover hidden street art alleys and the iconic bookstore.

itinerary.title: 12:15 PM - Durian Tarts & Farewell
itinerary.description: End with a durian pastry and say goodbye at Jalan Sultan.

name: Flavours of Malaysia
shortDescription: Brand new to Malaysia? This is everything you need to know! Perfect introduction to Malaysian culture.
fullDescription:
What's a better place to experience a country than a market? On this excursion, we take you through one of the largest wet markets in Kuala Lumpur. You will experience first-hand the sights, smells and flavours of the different cultures of Malaysia.

Walking through the market, you'll taste popular Malaysian dishes and understand the key ingredients used in the kitchens of the three main cultures of Malaysia. This market experience is 100% real.

highlights.highlight: Visit Chow Kit - one of KL's largest traditional wet markets
Watch "aunties" hand-making biscuits at Sin Hwa Bee Bakery
Taste jamu, cham, and the best pan mee in town
Walk through Kampung Periuk heritage village behind the skyline
Real vendor connections - every family knows our faces

itinerary.title: 11:15 AM - Cham, Jamu & Local Flavours

short_description: Brand new to Malaysia? This is everything you need to know! Perfect introduction to Malaysian culture.
full_description:
What's a better place to experience a country than a market? On this excursion, we take you through one of the largest wet markets in Kuala Lumpur. You will experience first-hand the sights, smells and flavours of the different cultures of Malaysia.

translations.short_description: 初来马来西亚？这里有您需要了解的一切！是介绍马来西亚文化的完美指南。
translations.full_description: 漫步于市场之中，您将品尝到备受欢迎的马来西亚美食，并了解马来西亚三大主要文化厨房中所使用的关键食材。这次市场体验百分之百真实。
highlights: 游览秋杰市场——吉隆坡最大的传统湿货市场之一
去新和美饼家看阿姨们手工制作饼干
品尝jamu、cham和镇上最好吃的板面
漫步穿越天际线背后的甘榜伯鲁克传统村落
真正的供应商关系 - 家家户户都认识我们

translations.name: Aromen Malaysias
translations.tagline: Marktkultur und verborgene Aromen
translations.short_description: "Brandneu in Malaysia? Das ist alles, was Sie wissen müssen! Perfekte Einführung in die malaysische Kultur."
translations.full_description: Beim Schlendern durch den Markt werden Sie beliebte malaysische Gerichte probieren und die wichtigsten Zutaten kennenlernen, die in den Küchen der drei Hauptkulturen Malaysias verwendet werden. Dieses Markterlebnis ist 100 % authentisch.
highlights: Besuchen Sie Chow Kit – einen der größten traditionellen Nassmärkte in KL.
Beobachten Sie, wie „Tanten" in der Bäckerei Sin Hwa Bee Kekse von Hand herstellen
Probieren Sie Jamu, Cham und die beste Pan Mee der Stadt
Spaziergang durch das Kulturerbe-Dorf Kampung Periuk hinter der Skyline
Echte Lieferantenverbindungen – jede Familie kennt unsere Gesichter

translations.name: Sabores de Malasia
translations.tagline: Cultura de Mercado y Sabores Ocultos
translations.short_description: ¿Totalmente nuevo en Malasia? ¡Esto es todo lo que necesitas saber! Introducción perfecta a la cultura malasia.
translations.full_description: Caminando por el mercado, probarás platos populares de Malasia y entenderás los ingredientes clave utilizados en las cocinas de las tres culturas principales de Malasia. Esta experiencia de mercado es 100% real.
highlights: Visita Chow Kit - uno de los mercados húmedos tradicionales más grandes de Kuala Lumpur
Mira a las "tías" haciendo galletas a mano en Sin Hwa Bee Bakery
Prueba el jamu, el cham y el mejor pan mee de la ciudad
Camina por la aldea patrimonial de Kampung Periuk detrás del horizonte urbano
Conexiones reales con proveedores: cada familia conoce nuestras caras.

translations.name: Saveurs de Malaisie
translations.tagline: Culture du marché et saveurs cachées
translations.short_description: Tout nouveau en Malaisie ? Voici tout ce que vous devez savoir ! Introduction parfaite à la culture malaisienne.
translations.full_description: En vous promenant dans le marché, vous goûterez à des plats populaires malaisiens et comprendrez les ingrédients clés utilisés dans les cuisines des trois principales cultures de Malaisie. Cette expérience au marché est 100 % authentique.
highlights: Visitez Chow Kit - l'un des plus grands marchés traditionnels de KL
Regardez les « tantes » fabriquer des biscuits à la main à la boulangerie Sin Hwa Bee
Goûtez le jamu, le cham, et le meilleur pan mee en ville
Promenez-vous à travers le village patrimonial de Kampung Periuk, derrière la ligne d'horizon
De vraies connexions avec les fournisseurs - chaque famille connaît nos visages

name: Eat Drink George Town
tagline: Street Food and Cocktails in Penang
shortDescription: Simply Enak's most-loved Penang tour starts as the sun sets.
fullDescription:
Eat Drink George Town is the perfect food trail for small groups who would like to taste Penang's street food while discovering the city's hidden stories. As night falls, Penang's street food scene comes alive with sizzling woks and bustling hawker stalls.

Your guide will lead you through the historic streets of George Town, sharing tales of secret societies, colonial history, and the multicultural heritage that makes Penang Malaysia's food capital.

highlights.highlight: Sizzling satay at a heritage Malay restaurant
Watch roti jala handcrafted like golden lace
Best samosas in Malaysia (locals' claim, not ours!)
Char kway teow at Chew Jetty at sunset
Alcoholic drink in a heritage setting

itinerary.title: 16:00 PM - Meet at Masjid Kapitan Keling

itinerary.title: 17:45 PM - Chew Jetty Sunset

itinerary.title: 18:30 PM - Clan Houses & Secret Society Tales
itinerary.description: Uncover how secret societies shaped Georgetown while tasting Penang Hokkien Mee.

itinerary.title: 19:30 PM - Drink & Farewell
itinerary.description: Toast with an alcoholic drink at a secret heritage bar.

translations.short_description: Simply Enak 最受欢迎的槟城之旅在日落时分开始。
translations.full_description: 您的向导将带领您穿越乔治市的古老街巷，讲述秘密社团的传奇、殖民时代的历史，以及造就槟城成为马来西亚美食之都的多元文化遗产。
highlights: 在传统马来餐厅享用滋滋作响的沙爹
观看手工制作的金色蕾丝般的网饼

translations.tagline: Straßenessen und Cocktails in Penang

translations.full_description: Ihr Guide führt Sie durch die historischen Straßen von George Town und erzählt Ihnen Geschichten über Geheimgesellschaften, die Kolonialgeschichte und das multikulturelle Erbe, das Penang zur kulinarischen Hauptstadt Malaysias macht.
highlights: Brutzelndes Saté in einem traditionsreichen malaiischen Restaurant
Beobachte, wie Roti Jala handgefertigt wird wie goldene Spitze
Die besten Samosas in Malaysia (sagen die Einheimischen, nicht wir!)
Char kway teow am Chew Jetty bei Sonnenuntergang
Alkoholisches Getränk in historischem Ambiente

translations.short_description: El tour más querido de Penang de Simply Enak comienza cuando se pone el sol.
translations.full_description: Tu guía te llevará por las calles históricas de George Town, compartiendo relatos de sociedades secretas, historia colonial y el patrimonio multicultural que convierte a Penang en la capital gastronómica de Malasia.
highlights: Satay chisporroteante en un restaurante malayo tradicional
Mira el roti jala elaborado a mano como encaje dorado
Los mejores samosas de Malasia (¡según los locales, no nosotros!)
Char kway teow en Chew Jetty al atardecer
Bebida alcohólica en un entorno patrimonial

Boisson alcoolisée dans un cadre patrimonial
